hooks.command: D=$(pwd); case "$D" in */.claude/worktrees/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; if [ ! -f "$D/package.json" ] || [ -d "$D/node_modules" ]; then exit 0; fi; LOG=/tmp/claude-worktree-setup.log; if pnpm install > "$LOG" 2>&1; then echo '{"systemMessage": "Worktree deps installed: pnpm install"}'; else echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"Worktree dependency install failed - see $LOG\"}"; fi
